get_human_normalized_score: convert a raw Atari game score to a human-normalized score between 0 and 1
list_atari_games: get the sorted tuple of all 57 Atari game names from the ATARI_GAMES constant
lookup_atari_baseline: look up the random and human baseline scores for a specific Atari game from _ATARI_DATA
compute_normalized_score_pong: compute the human-normalized score for a Pong raw score of 10 using get_human_normalized_score
compare_agent_to_human: compare an agent raw score against human performance by normalizing it with get_human_normalized_score
